2607.11464.title: FAIR GraphRAG: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation Approach for Semantic Data Analysis
2607.11464.paper_summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) addresses the limitations of Large Language Models (LLMs) when providing responses to domain-specific questions. Graph-based RAG approaches, such as GraphRAG, enhance retrieval by capturing semantic relationships within knowledge graphs (KGs). While the FAIR principles (Findability, Accessibility, Interoperability, and Reusability) are becoming prevalent for scientific data management, especially in complex domains such as medicine, existing RAG approaches lack a structured FAIRification of the underlying knowledge resources. This lack limits their potential for FAIR information retrieval in these domains. To address this gap, we introduce FAIR GraphRAG, a novel framework that integrates FAIR Digital Objects (FDOs) as the fundamental units of a graph-based retrieval system. Each graph node represents an FDO that incorporates core data, metadata, persistent identifiers, and semantic links. We leverage LLMs to support schema construction and automated extraction of content and metadata from data sources. The framework was co-designed by physicians and computer scientists to ensure technical and clinical relevance. We apply FAIR GraphRAG to a biomedical dataset in gastroenterology, demonstrating its applicability to RNA-sequencing data. Beyond ensuring adherence to the FAIR principles, FAIR GraphRAG significantly improves question answering accuracy, coverage, and explainability, particularly for complex queries involving metadata and ontology links. This work shows the feasibility of combining FAIR data practices with graph-based retrieval techniques. We see potential for applying our approach to other specialized fields such as education and business.
2607.11464.paper_summary_zh: 檢索增強生成（RAG）解決了大型語言模型（LLMs）在回答特定領域問題時的局限性。基於圖形的 RAG 方法，例如 GraphRAG，通過捕捉知識圖譜（KGs）中的語義關係來增強檢索。雖然 FAIR 原則（可尋找性、可訪問性、互操作性和可重用性）在科學數據管理中越來越普遍，特別是在醫學等複雜領域，但現有的 RAG 方法缺乏對基礎知識資源的結構化 FAIR 化。這一缺失限制了它們在這些領域進行 FAIR 信息檢索的潛力。為了解決這一空白，我們介紹了 FAIR GraphRAG，一個將 FAIR 數字對象（FDOs）整合為基於圖形的檢索系統基本單元的新框架。每個圖形節點代表一個 FDO，該 FDO 包含核心數據、元數據、持久標識符和語義鏈接。我們利用 LLMs 來支持模式構建和從數據源自動提取內容和元數據。該框架由醫生和計算機科學家共同設計，以確保技術和臨床的相關性。我們將 FAIR GraphRAG 應用於一個胃腸病學的生物醫學數據集，展示其對 RNA 測序數據的適用性。除了確保遵循 FAIR 原則外，FAIR GraphRAG 顯著提高了問題回答的準確性、覆蓋範圍和可解釋性，特別是對涉及元數據和本體鏈接的複雜查詢。這項工作顯示了將 FAIR 數據實踐與基於圖形的檢索技術相結合的可行性。我們看到將我們的方法應用於教育和商業等其他專業領域的潛力。
